I've been looking for you.[XENO:n ]
So this is where you were.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Apologies. Was everyone worried?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Of course. Me especially.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hmm?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It's just... I've been thinking about Fiorung,[XENO:n ]
and I can't help wondering...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Wondering what?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]You saw how Fiorung acted. It was like[XENO:n ]
she didn't even recognise us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Yes. It's unsettling.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
But Shulk, don't get me wrong. I'm not sad.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Even if she doesn't recognise me,[XENO:n ]
I'm glad to know she's alive.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dunban-san...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You see, Fiorung was born many years after me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]

And not long afterwards, we lost[XENO:n ]
our father to a Machine God Soldier.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It was left to me to protect and raise her.[XENO:n ]
Almost like a father.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I was always jealous that she had you as her brother.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Ah yes. You and Fiorung used to be inseparable.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I need to tell you something.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I always thought, if Fiorung were to be[XENO:n ]
with anyone, it should be you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]W-why!? If you want to stay together[XENO:n ]
forever, then Rein should...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Yeah, he does. But Fiorung[XENO:n ]
doesn't like him in that way.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ]Oh, I see.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
He's a nice guy.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Reminds me of myself when I was his age,[XENO:n ]
all reckless and hot-headed.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Probably why he's not right for her.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Listen, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Yes?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
A lost life can never be returned.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But she's alive. It doesn't matter that[XENO:n ]
she's lost her memory.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Yeah... I guess you're right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Fiorung and I have spent our entire lives together.[XENO:n ]
The memory of that can't have disappeared completely.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It's up to us. We have to help her remember.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Help me, Shulk. Help me get her back![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You know I will.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK. Let's go tell the others.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
